metadata.purpose: Define the instruction framework for projecting user requests into JWRS, carrying out tasks, and reporting execution outcomes and evidence.
metadata.schemaNotation: Custom descriptive schemas: keys declares named fields; additional keys controls extra fields. Translate these descriptions to standard JSON Schema before using a JSON Schema validator.

responseType.reason: Identifies the structural category of the governing artifact so executing interpreters recognize it as a procedural custom instruction rather than an execution result or data record.
responseType.source: AGENTS-root-array.json line 4 (also AGENTS-original-reference.json line 3 as response_type).

instructionId.reason: Provides the persistent, unique canonical identifier for this specific governing procedure across revisions and environments.
instructionId.source: AGENTS-root-array.json line 5 (also AGENTS-original-reference.json line 4 as instruction_id).

version.reason: Establishes the document release revision baseline to prevent version drift between working drafts and project references.

purpose.reason: Articulates the concise, self-contained procedural mandate of the document itself: projecting requests into JWRS, executing in the same turn, auditing tools, and returning verified evidence.

instructionScope.reason: Defines the boundary conditions under which this governing instruction applies (every user prompt), distinguishing procedure applicability from prompt-specific operational scopes.
instructionScope.source: AGENTS-root-array.json line 8 (and AGENTS-original-reference.json line 6 as scope).

schemaNotation.reason: Resolves the schema dialect rule directly within document metadata, explaining that keys and additionalKeys describe schema structure without violating the constraint against reintroducing properties into the working document.

agentsMdProvenance.reason: Rejected as a static metadata wrapper. Live backing file and library IDs change per retrieval and duplicate pre-execution inputs.

authoritativeFile_and_mirror.reason: Belongs in the operational 'Load the Governing Instruction' section as an inspection reference rather than document-level metadata.

userGoal_and_scope.reason: These are prompt-specific inputs captured under 'Interpret the User Request', not static procedure metadata.

basis_and_fixed.reason: These are dynamic state-change inputs belonging strictly in 'Describe the State Change'.

profile_and_selectionRationale.reason: These belong exclusively to the mode selection decision process.

timestamps_and_decorative_headers.reason: Explicitly forbidden by guidance to prevent ungrounded synthetic values and decoration.

governingInstructionFileId.necessity: Identifies the current physical backing file in the runtime Library; cannot be statically hardcoded because file overwrites generate new identifiers.
governingInstructionFileId.capture_question: What is the current backing file ID returned by live retrieval of the governing instruction?
governingInstructionFileId.source: Runtime retrieval metadata of /AGENTS.md from the active environment interface.

governingInstructionLibraryFileId.necessity: Identifies the persistent Library record; distinct from the backing file ID and cannot be fabricated from historical reference snapshots.
governingInstructionLibraryFileId.capture_question: What is the persistent Library record ID returned by the same live retrieval of the governing instruction?
governingInstructionLibraryFileId.source: Runtime retrieval metadata of /AGENTS.md from the active environment interface.
